content:
Substitute \(x+2\) into the original equation:

\[
f(x+4)+f(x)=f(x+2)
\]

Substitute \(x+4\):

\[
f(x+6)+f(x+2)=f(x+4)
\]

Using \(f(x+4)=f(x+2)-f(x)\), we get:

\[
f(x+6)+f(x+2)=f(x+2)-f(x)
\]

so

\[
f(x+6)=-f(x)
\]

Then

\[
f(x+12)=-f(x+6)=f(x)
\]

Thus one integer period is \(12\).

\[
\boxed{12}
\]
